cases.name: Brittany Sue Battaglia
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Brittany was an Artist, Esthetician, cosmetologist and nail tech." AJ Battaglia said his sister "was just a very good person." "She got along with everybody," he said. "She tries to see the good in everybody, doesn't matter who you are. She had such a diverse friend group, which was really cool to see."

Battaglia was described as a free-spirited woman who loved music and helping others.

"The best parts of her nature were used against her," (Quamieshia Greathouse, Battaglia's roommate and best friend) said. "I was trying to keep hope. She meant everything to me."

cases.name: Alexandria Nance
cases.about: "This tragedy does not define our family," said Cara Esters. The victims include her siblings, nieces and nephew. "They were loved by so many people. They were loving people, a loving family," said Latisha Fox, a family friend. Esters said her entire family was born and raised in the Joliet area, and on Sunday night, she has been finding peace through the legacy her loved ones have left on that community. "It is joyous and it is comforting to know they are loved and that so many people remember their names and let their legacy live on, Cara said. Cara spoke about how she wants her family to be remembered. "Love and laughter. My family was all about, and is, and will forever be about love and laughter," she said.
